crossRefs.note: Yahweh, the God of Israel, you are righteous; for we are left a remnant that has escaped, as it is today. Behold, we…
However you are just in all that has come on us; for you have dealt truly, but we have done wickedly.
“Yahweh is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment. Please hear all you peoples, and see my sorrow. My…
It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail.
“Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of face, as it is today; to the men of Judah, and to the…
Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me.

translations.web: Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
translations.bsb: The LORD is righteous; He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.
translations.kjv: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
translations.asv: Jehovah is righteous: He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
